---
name: Building review or improvement
about: Compare one building or propose a focused model change
title: "[Building] "
---

## Building and location

Name, OSM ID if known, and Minecraft coordinates/world name:

## What needs to change?

Describe the side or feature: footprint, height, roof, windows, materials, entrance or connection to terrain. Separate observations from estimates.

## Reference and model comparison

Attach comparable views or links. For references, include date, viewpoint, credit and reuse permission if you are supplying an image. Do not upload private interior information.

## Proposed scope

What small part would you like to work on? State whether you are reporting a problem, offering reference material, or volunteering to build/code.

## How could this be checked?

Describe the measurements, views or in-game checks that would demonstrate improvement. Note what would still be uncertain.
